observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox console with a matching white controller resting on top.
The console has a textured surface with diagonal lines and a visible disc slot on the front.
The controller has the standard Xbox layout: D-pad, analog sticks, and colored action buttons (green, red, blue, yellow).
The console is plugged into a wall socket with multiple power adapters and cables visible in the background.
The console appears to be in a room with beige walls and wooden furniture.
There is a watermark 'GAME VILLAGE POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.

risks.risk: Controller may not function properly or may be missing accessories (e.g., battery, cables)
risks.proof: Video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may have physical damage not visible in the photo (e.g., cracks, dents, or disc drive issues)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console's front, back, and disc drive area, and a video showing the disc drive opening and closing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the Xbox dashboard.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning with the console.
Close-up photos of the console's front, back, and disc drive area.
Photo of the console's model number or serial number (if any) to verify authenticity.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
